class.name: StreamRequestQueue
class.brief_description: Prioritised streaming request queue with generations.
class.description: Every request is stamped with a generation (for example a counter bumped whenever the player's interest set changes). [method cancel_stale] drops queued requests that are no longer wanted and flags in-flight ones, so late results are ignored by [method complete].

method.name: get_newest_generation
method.description: Returns the newest generation seen so far.

method.name: request
method.description: Queues or re-prioritises [param cell]. Higher priority is served first. Returns [code]false[/code] if [param generation] is older than one already seen or [param priority] is not finite. Invalid priorities do not change the newest generation.

method.name: cancel_stale
method.description: Cancels every request older than [param current_generation] except those in [param keep_cells], which are re-stamped. Queued requests are removed, in-flight ones are flagged. Returns the number of cancelled requests.

method.name: next_batch
method.description: Pops up to [param budget] highest-priority queued requests (ties in FIFO order) and marks them in flight, honouring [member max_in_flight].

method.name: complete
method.description: Delivers a finished load. Returns [code]false[/code] and discards the result when the request was cancelled, superseded by a newer generation or never existed.

method.name: take_completed
method.description: Returns and clears the delivered results as dictionaries with [code]cell[/code], [code]result[/code] and [code]generation[/code].

method.name: has_request
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param cell] has a tracked request.

method.name: state_of
method.description: Returns the [enum State] of [param cell], or [code]-1[/code] when it has no request.

method.name: queued_count
method.description: Returns the number of queued requests.

method.name: in_flight_count
method.description: Returns the number of in-flight requests, including cancelled ones that have not reported back.

method.name: clear
method.description: Resets the queue, generations and statistics.

members.member: Cap on simultaneously in-flight requests ([code]0[/code] means unlimited).
